topic: The Most Beautiful Bridge: Understanding Euler's Formula
target_audience: Advanced high school students or first-year university students

sections.title: The Grand Collision of Worlds
lecture_lines: Meet e, pi, and i: three separate mathematical worlds.
For centuries, these constants appeared completely unrelated.
But a hidden bridge exists between these distant islands.
Let's explore the signpost where these paths finally meet.
This is Euler’s formula, the most beautiful in math.
animations: Display three floating 'islands' [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/island.svg] with 'e' (#88CA5E), 'pi' (#FF9D00), and 'i' (#58C4DD) symbols.
Animate the islands [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/island.svg] drifting closer together on a black background.
Merge the islands [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/island.svg] into a single, unified landscape with a golden glow (#FFD700).
Place a signpost [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/signpost.svg] in the center of the merged landscape.
Fade in the formula e^(i*pi) + 1 = 0 on the signpost [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/signpost.svg] in white (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Hidden Power of 'i'
lecture_lines: In math, i is the root of negative one.
Geometrically, multiplying by i creates a ninety-degree rotation.
It turns a horizontal real number into a vertical one.
animations: Draw a complex plane; show a white arrow (#FFFFFF) pointing from origin to 1.
Rotate the white arrow 90 degrees to point at 'i' (#58C4DD).
Rotate the arrow another 90 degrees to point at -1 (#FF0000).

sections.title: The Engine: Continuous Growth in a New Direction
lecture_lines: The number e typically represents continuous exponential growth.
Multiplying by i rotates this growth by ninety degrees.
This constant turning forces the path into a perfect circle.
animations: Show the engine icon [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/engine.svg] at (1,0) on a complex plane with a small velocity vector.
Rotate the velocity vector to always be 90 degrees relative to the engine's position from origin.
The engine icon [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/engine.svg] moves, tracing a white circle (#FFFFFF) as it continuously 'grows' sideways.

sections.title: Mapping the Circle: Euler's General Formula
lecture_lines: Euler’s formula maps this circular path on a plane.
The expression e to the ix tracks our position.
Cosine measures how far we are horizontally.
Sine measures our vertical height on the complex plane.
Together, they define every point on the unit circle.
animations: Show a unit circle on the complex plane with a radius line at angle 'x'.
Project a green line (#88CA5E) onto the real axis, labeled 'cos(x)'.
Project a blue line (#58C4DD) onto the imaginary axis, labeled 'i*sin(x)'.
Display the equation e^{ix} = cos(x) + i*sin(x) in the corner.
Animate the radius line rotating, showing the cos and sin lengths changing.

sections.title: The Final Destination: pi i
lecture_lines: Now, we travel a distance of exactly pi.
This path covers half of the unit circle's circumference.
We land precisely at negative one on the complex plane.
animations: Show the unit circle with a marker starting at 1 on the real axis.
Move the marker along the top half of the circle's circumference.
The marker lands at -1 on the real axis, highlighting the value in red (#FF0000).

sections.title: Summary: Elegance in Unity
lecture_lines: Consider five fundamental constants of the mathematical universe.
They unite perfectly in this one simple, elegant statement.
Zero, one, e, i, and pi combined forever.
This formula is the golden key to mathematical harmony.
We have reached the bridge: elegance in unity.
animations: Arrange the symbols 0, 1, e, i, and pi randomly on the screen.
Morph the layout into the structured equation e^{i*pi} + 1 = 0.
Flash each constant in its unique color (e:#88CA5E, pi:#FF9D00, i:#58C4DD, 1:#FFFFFF, 0:#FFFFFF).
Transform the entire equation into a single glowing golden key (#FFD700) [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/key.svg].
Fade in the title 'Elegance in Unity' below the golden key [Asset: /mmfs1/data/group/pmc082/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/key.svg].
